turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. For the contiguous U.S., estimated transit time after that is 1–3 days on the West Coast, 3–4 days in the Central U.S., 4–5 days in the Midwest, and 5–7 days on the East Coast.
These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates. You’ll receive a tracking email when your order is ready to ship. See our Shipping & Delivery page for the latest information.
